_evidence: 0x00406ac7 walks the 0x160-byte record ring at 0x008943a0 (edi = a ring record, as its callers 0x406dbb/0x406ebc pass; fixed here at record 0) whose end pointer is [0x00866ecc] (0x4069d2 wraps forward to 0x8943a0 at it, 0x4069e6 wraps backward to end-0x160). 0x4067ea classifies a record (CF) from fpatan angles of (X0,Y0)=dwords 0x006278c0/0x006278c8 relative to record points (words +0xd4/+0xd6 and +0xdc/+0xde, each <<8 plus dwords +0xf0/+0xf8), scaled by the f64 0x006f2be4 and fistp'd, then compared (signed, wrapping) with word +0x128<<16, dword +0xec+-0x40000000, word +0x12a<<16, dwords +0x104 and +0x110. Every bit pattern is fault-free (fild of ints, masked FPU), but the forward loop only stops at a CF=0 record and the backward loop at a CF=1 record, so a ring without both kinds never terminates (not a state the game can be in). The ring is therefore at least 4 records ([0x866ecc] = base + k*0x160, k 4..26) and two records are pinned: record 2 always returns CF=1 (+0x128=0x1357 with +0x104=0x13570001 sends 0x406937 to stc unless a1 == 0x13570000 exactly, and +0x12a=0x2468 with +0x110=0x2467ffff then sends 0x406979 to stc unless a2 == 0x2467ffff exactly), record 3 always returns CF=0 (+0x128<<16 == +0xec+0x40000000 == +0x104 == 0x40000000 and +0x110 == +0x12a<<16 == 0 make every comparison group pass to clc whatever the angles). All other record fields and records 0,1,4..25 vary freely, so both loops run with varied lengths and wrap. 0x006f2be4 is set at startup by 0x527476 to 2^31/fldpi (bits 0x41c45f306dc9c883; zero in the image, so it is supplied here as that constant).
